function.name: time_converter
function.description: Converts the local time of user's region to the target region's local time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_timezone.description: The timezone of the user in string format. Example: 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)'

target_timezone.description: The target timezone in string format where user wants to know the local time. Example: 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'

time.description: The local time of user's timezone in string format (24 hr format). Optional parameter. Example: '15:30:00'

message.content: 截至最近的估算，紐約市（New York City）的總人口約為 **850萬**。如果你指的是整個紐約州（State of New York），則人口約為 **1950萬**。這些數字基於美國人口普查局和其他官方統計資料，可能會隨時間略有變動。

There's no mention of time conversion. So we can just answer with the approximate population. According to recent estimates, New York City has about 8.5 million people. But maybe they want the population of the state? The question says "紐約現在的人口是多少？" It could refer to New York City or the state. Usually, when someone asks "New York population", they might mean the city. Let's give both: NYC ~8.5 million, State ~19.5 million. Provide approximate numbers.
